Answer: C
Reason: Figure 1a (axial CT) shows a right-sided pleural effusion and mediastinal widening with an arrow pointing to a suspected perforation site or abscess near the esophagus, consistent with complications from fishbone impaction. Figure 2 (chest X-ray) confirms the right-sided pleural effusion (blunting of the costophrenic angle and opacity). This combination points to a right-sided pleural effusion associated with a mediastinal process like an abscess.
